message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The fact: drunk driving. In Chinese criminal law, drunk driving is a crime of "危险驾驶" (dangerous driving) under Article 133 of Criminal Law (dangerous driving causing traffic accidents). However if no accident, still dangerous driving? Actually Chinese law: "危险驾驶罪" (dangerous driving) applies when the driver under influence of alcohol or other intoxicants drives a motor vehicle, causing dangerous circumstances. The typical charge is "危险驾驶" (dangerous driving). In examples earlier, they used "危险驾驶" for drunk driving. For example earlier: "危 难驾驶;私分国有资产" etc. So answer: [罪名]危险驾驶<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes? Only drunk driving, no accident, no other. So single crime.
